title: Exclude compensated P104 fusion readouts (0% κ change)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN. Exact conditional κ change 0%.** On exact #7334, the one-helper fusion screen exhausted 3,422 paid pairs. It fixes the original paid itineraries except the fused helper pair, and uses one maximal public scalar component with at most 24 events and 20 roles, one low-chart peer, and a shared legal retiming cut. Of 456 geometry survivors, all 1,197 strict paired keys fail exterior support. Allowing the virtual helper’s owned output to be cleared and restoring the dirty public helper with a nonzero scalar leaves 820 nonlocal forward failures and 377 one-peer readout failures. Independent integer rank certificates exclude all 43 forward-feasible extensions to the full high-chart readout bank. Zero cases remain unresolved within scope.

The complete 17-copy signed invoice has 110,519 paid and 22,461 productive positions, surplus 1,424 and no empty credit. The one-edit optimistic upper is 0.380712103179 raw units, rounded upward, and an extra paid rank-one position kills it. Actual compatible saving is zero. The peer benchmark is κ = 0.00364665195644 on #7334 at aaeec8c0acf01e99a5f331ef363a698d9c084ace, independently reproduced from all four registered stages. Its separate gain over #7314 is exactly 0.000000430519994.

## Replay

~~~sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-compensated-fusion-readout-bound/replay.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-compensated-fusion-readout-bound
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-compensated-fusion-readout-bound --check-modes --check-source-history
~~~

All 17 pinned receipts reproduce, with known-good #319 reconstruction and negative controls. Registered replay, committed bytes/modes/source history, Git-free export and six navigation tests passed locally. No literal candidate passed support. Larger components, different clocks or paid itineraries, and multiple low peers remain outside scope. The branch retains the #7257 replay prerequisites.

## Credit and overlap

#7334 supplies the closed-block fusion and restored dirty return, #7314 its parent, #7113 the fixed signed caller, and #7298 the directed tariff. #7308 supplies retained owned-MOVE evidence and related separating-coordinate methods. #6529 and #6765 are compensated-fusion and resident-response precedents on earlier words, and #7312/#7329 have different fixed-contact scopes. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted.
